title: Soloist in a Cage
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Chloe and her baby brother Locke were born inside a walled prison city full of dangerous criminals, and with their parents gone Chloe cares for him alone. When three soldiers break out, Chloe escapes with them but loses Locke on the way; years later, trained and armed, she returns to the prison city to find her now eleven-year-old brother and bring him out.
life_message: Love for family is worth any danger, and a promise to protect someone is kept no matter what it costs.
